# pip-audit, installed by audit.yml. A manifest so Dependabot's pip entry sees
# the pin. Not hash-pinned, unlike requirements.txt (installed with
# --require-hashes by actionlint.yml): hashing pip-audit would pin its
# transitive tree, and fresh transitives are what the audit judges. A new
# transitive release can turn the gate red on an unchanged commit: the gate
# working, not a flake.
pip-audit==2.10.1
